<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**3** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **147** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7eb613c39fb85cc1e4d0b658c9ecea4e45949c99` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `afa981afe9d17aa6d4ea6571d5cf05104acb6cc4` — the merge of head `c203ef8349f6371f0b4fd79d15be3c1786e50f50` into base `7eb613c39fb85cc1e4d0b658c9ecea4e45949c99`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin afa981afe9d17aa6d4ea6571d5cf05104acb6cc4 && git checkout afa981afe9d17aa6d4ea6571d5cf05104acb6cc4
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7eb613c39fb85cc1e4d0b658c9ecea4e45949c99 c203ef8349f6371f0b4fd79d15be3c1786e50f50 && git checkout -B drift-repro 7eb613c39fb85cc1e4d0b658c9ecea4e45949c99 && git merge --no-ff c203ef8349f6371f0b4fd79d15be3c1786e50f50

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7eb613c39fb85cc1e4d0b658c9ecea4e45949c99
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f70fec428934676006220cee1be3f35c5199bd85`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts + packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.test.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.test.ts, docs/adr/0109-ai-tool-authoring-model.md, ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts, ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-sentences-12724.test.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts (chatbot.tool block), ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/package.json, .github/workflows/ci.yml (filter + Test UI), cloud `claude/project-thread-eb1lm2` @ 799c4ab6f004: packages/service-ai/src/tools/package-docs-tools.ts, packages/service-ai/src/tools/index.ts, packages/service-ai/src/__tests__/platform-tool-names-conformance.test.ts, packages/service-ai-studio/src/skills/package-docs-skill.ts

### ① Derived judgments

- `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai']` gains `read_package_doc` and `search_package_docs` — **right**. At cloud head 799c4ab6f004 the owning package's `DEFINED_HERE` (data-tools: `aggregate_data`, `get_record`, `query_records`; `query_data`; `visualize_data`; `search_knowledge`; `PACKAGE_DOCS_TOOL_DEFINITIONS`: `search_package_docs`, `read_package_doc`) sorted is exactly the eight names the PR's group now carries, so the conformance test's set-equality turns green at the pin and the group stays "the exact set that package registers" as the file's own contract demands. Placement is sorted under JS default order (`query_records`, `read_package_doc`, `search_knowledge`, `search_package_docs`, `visualize_data`), so the spec invariant test's "each group is sorted" case holds; both names are snake_case, collide with nothing in `service-ai-studio`, and sit outside the `action_` family namespace.
- `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES` and `isPlatformProvidedToolName` accept two more names — **right**; derived mechanically from the flattened registry, no code change.
- The lint accept-set for `skill.tools[]` under `ai-skill-tool-unresolved` widens by exactly two literal names (and a `read_*` trailing wildcard now resolves where it did not) — **right**. `collectToolUniverse` seeds from `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES`; nothing else in the ladder moves. The new test's control (`list_package_docs` at `skills[0].tools[2]`) is a correct index and a name no source supplies, so the pin can fail on an over-widened universe, matching the #16512 shape beside it.
- The cloud consumer's skill `package_docs` names exactly `['search_package_docs', 'read_package_doc']` — **right**: the two names the registry now resolves are the two the first consumer writes; `ask`-only, registered only when `mountAsk && protocol`, which is the runtime's business, not the registry's.
- `ui/` `chatbot.tool.*` required key set widens by two — **wrong, and unsupplied**. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts` reads `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE` from `@objectstack/spec` resolved `workspace:^` (ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/package.json) since the ui/ import at fd40831416, and asserts every registry name carries a non-empty `chatbot.tool.` + the tool name as its label in all ten packs (`it.each(LANGS)` … `missing … toEqual([])`); `toolLabels-sentences-12724.test.ts` further requires every pack's key set to equal `en`'s and no value to equal the title-caser output. `grep search_package_docs|read_package_doc ui/` returns nothing. The registry change therefore implies ten locale entries (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh) that the diff does not carry. See ④.
- No Zod shape, no export added or removed, no generated artifact owed beyond `check:generated` (CI's) — right; `Check Changeset` and `Spec property liveness` concluded success.
- No `packages/mcp` consumer reads the registry at this head (`grep isPlatformProvidedToolName packages/mcp/src` is empty), so the precedent changeset's "second consumer" sentence is stale history, not a derived obligation here.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/27002-service-ai-package-doc-tool-names.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': minor` — **matches the diff**. A published constant's value widens (the accept-set of a lint rule the spec hands downstream grows), nothing is removed or renamed, so `(widening)` and `minor` are the right arm and level; `Metadata-protocol: added` is right under AGENTS.md step 3 ("accepted value … is `added`", kind takes at least `minor`): two more `skill.tools[]` values an author can write without the ADR-0109 finding. `packages/lint` moves only a test file, so no second changeset is owed. Declarations agree across card claim, PR body and changeset body. `Check Changeset` concluded success on this head.
Clause-②: yes (widening)

### ③ Boundary flags

- Claim `Premise: holds` — verified: at `origin/main` 5e99bd936c `platform-tool-names.ts` carries neither name and carries `search_knowledge`. Right.
- Claim `File surface` (registry, the lint pin, one changeset) — matches the three-file diff exactly. Right.
- Claim `Governed: no` — right: the register is `docs/adr/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `ui/AGENTS.md`, `ui/CLAUDE.md`, `ui/.github/workflows/**`; none touched; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success.
- Card body "Update any spec test or snapshot that pins the list": the spec's own `platform-tool-names.test.ts` pins invariants only (snake_case, no cross-package collision, no `action_` prefix, sorted) and all four hold for the two names; no snapshot exists under `packages/spec`. The sweep stopped at `packages/spec`: the pin that does enumerate the registry lives under `ui/` (① above) and is **not** answered — escalated as the must-fix in ④.
- Card `open_questions`: none in body or comment.
- PR body "Downstream: live Ask transcript not done, recorded on the cloud card" — outside this PR's tree; noted, not a flag on this diff.
- PR body says precedent #16844 "同样声明 Clause-② yes (widening)": the precedent changeset at 625b0c32b4 carries no declaration lines (it predates them). Not load-bearing for this verdict; the declarations here are judged on their own and are right.
- Check-runs on `f70fec428934676006220cee1be3f35c5199bd85` at review time: success — Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Flag docs affected, Auto Label, filter, Plan Test Core shards, Dogfood Regression Gate, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Type Check · source gates. Pending — Build Core, Test Core (1–8/8), Build UI Deps, Type Check · workspace / consumer gates / debt ledger, Lint · CI release & engine gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure; Type Check UI and Build & E2E UI not yet started. Skipped by path filter — UI Published Artifacts, Build Docs, Dogfood shards, Temporal Conformance. **No `Test UI (k/16)` shard exists on this head**: ci.yml gates the shards on `filter.outputs.ui`, whose globs do not include `packages/spec/**` (that path sits only in `ui_consumers`, which drives Type Check UI and Build & E2E UI), and the `Test UI` aggregator passes a shard skip that filter explains. Judged on what has concluded; nothing concluded red.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts` — against ADR-0109 §2 ("platform tool names are facts, not guesses"; the owning package's conformance test is what keeps the group true), the file's own maintenance contract ("registering a new tool in a cloud AI package means adding its name here … an out-of-date registry is worse than no registry, because consumers now trust it"), and the first consumer at cloud 799c4ab6f004:

- Holds against the ruling and the first consumer: the two names are what `service-ai` registers, in the group's order, under the invariants the spec test pins, and the lint rule's resolution ladder accepts them and nothing else new. The group's doc line stating the pair sits behind the `/meta/doc` audience gate is read true in `package-docs-tools.ts` (gate asked via the protocol's list read, never restated) — a code comment, so the tracker cite is allowed.
- **Must-fix — the registry widening is half of one change; its ui/ half is missing.** The registry is, by the i18n packs' own header, the closed member set of `chatbot.tool.*` ("one entry per PLATFORM-PROVIDED tool name … the closed registry those runtimes are conformance-tested against"), and `toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts` enforces that identity against the in-tree spec. On this tree the test reddens on all ten `it.each(LANGS)` cases (`missing: ['read_package_doc', 'search_package_docs']`), and the sentences test's equal-key-set case follows the moment any one pack is patched alone. This is exactly the objectui#7481 symptom the test was written to prevent — a zh console showing "Search package docs" through the English title-caser fallback — and it recurs "every time the cloud AI packages register a tool", which is this PR. The failure is not caught on this head: `Test UI` shards never run for a `packages/spec`-only diff, so the red lands on `main` and reddens `Test UI`, a required context, on the next PR that touches `ui/**` — the "red that lands rides main into every later PR" failure AGENTS.md names, on a required gate. The precedent #16844 could leave the labels to a pin bump because ui/ then lived in another repo on a pinned spec and carried the `AHEAD_OF_PIN` hatch; since fd40831416 ui/ resolves `@objectstack/spec` as `workspace:^` and the hatch is empty by design, so AGENTS.md step 4's rule for removals applies in substance to this addition: the change that breaks `ui/` ships with the `ui/` fix or does not ship. Fix: add `chatbot.tool.read_package_doc` and `chatbot.tool.search_package_docs` to all ten packs under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/` as sentences in each pack's language (not the tool id, not the title-caser output), in the same PR; that also puts a `ui/**` path on the diff and runs `Test UI` on the head, which is the only way the gate verdict covers this consumer.
- Should-fix (not blocking): the card and PR body's "spec test or snapshot that pins the list" sweep should name the ui parity test as the pin, so the next registry widening does not miss it again; a one-line pointer in the registry file's maintenance-contract comment ("and its `chatbot.tool.*` label in every ui/ i18n pack") would make the obligation visible where the next author edits.
- No other break found: wildcard resolution, the `action_` family, `suggestName` near-miss, `PLATFORM_TOOL_FAMILY_PREFIXES` and the cloud `ask-tool-surface` exhaustive lists are all consistent with the two names.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `29111be8a75224b2c98eb1f9dfb995be6c132425`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts + ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt,ru,zh}.ts (chatbot.tool block), ui/.changeset/27002-chatbot-tool-labels-package-docs.md, .changeset/config.json, ui/AGENTS.md (changeset rule), ui/packages/i18n/package.json, ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/tool-display.ts (humanizeToolName), ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts, ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-sentences-12724.test.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/all-locales-key-parity.test.ts, .github/workflows/ci.yml (filter + Test UI); the f70fec4289 scope (lint rule and test, spec invariant test, ADR-0109, cloud `claude/project-thread-eb1lm2` @ 799c4ab6f004 service-ai tools) stands as judged in the prior record and is unchanged by this delta.

Delta review: one commit after `f70fec428934676006220cee1be3f35c5199bd85` — `29111be8a7` "feat(i18n): chatbot.tool labels for the two service-ai package-doc tools (#27002)", 12 files: the registry comment, ten locale packs, one changeset under `ui/.changeset/`. The three files of the prior head are byte-identical except the registry's maintenance-contract comment.

### ① Derived judgments

- The prior record's open derived obligation — the `ui/` `chatbot.tool.*` key set widens by two — is now **supplied, right**. Every one of the ten packs under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/` gains exactly `read_package_doc` and `search_package_docs` inside its `chatbot.tool` block (two insertions per file, same two keys, placed beside `search_knowledge`), so `toolLabels-locale-parity-7481`'s per-pack `missing` list is empty, `toolLabels-sentences-12724`'s equal-key-set case holds (every pack's key set equals `en`'s), and `all-locales-key-parity` (every pack defines every `en` key and no extra) holds.
- Sentence rule — **right in all ten**. `humanizeToolName` yields `Read package doc` and `Search package docs` (underscores to spaces, first word capitalised, `HUMAN_WORDS` touches none of these words); the test compares `value === id || value === humanizeToolName(id)`. `en` reads "Read the app guide" / "Search the app guides"; the nine other packs are phrases in their own script or language (zh 「阅读应用文档」/「在应用文档中查找」, ja, ko, ru, ar, de, es, fr, pt). None equals the id or the title-caser output.
- `@object-ui/i18n` (18.2.0, a member of the root fixed version group, 38 `@object-ui/*` entries in `.changeset/config.json`) gains two exported locale keys — a `patch`-level change with no authorable metadata surface. Right as declared (see ②) — but the declaration lives in a file the release does not read (④).
- No other derived change: `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE`, `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES`, the lint accept-set, the spec changeset and the cloud consumer's set-equality are exactly as judged on f70fec4289.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/27002-service-ai-package-doc-tool-names.md` (`@objectstack/spec: minor`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`) — unchanged, still matches the diff; `Check Changeset` concluded success on this head (both runs).
- `ui/.changeset/27002-chatbot-tool-labels-package-docs.md` (`'@object-ui/i18n': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`) — the **content** is right: locale labels widen no published spec surface and change nothing a metadata author writes; `none` takes `patch` under AGENTS.md step 3, and the same trio is what every precedent `@object-ui/i18n` label changeset carries (`13460-console-pages-i18n`, `13460-console-second-pass`, `13461-keyboard-and-names`). The **location** is wrong — ④.
Clause-②: yes (widening)

### ③ Boundary flags

- The prior record's must-fix (ten `chatbot.tool.*` labels) — **answered**; the prior should-fix (registry comment pointing at the label requirement) — **answered**: the maintenance-contract paragraph now says a new name also needs its `chatbot.tool.` label in every pack under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/` because the plugin-chatbot label-parity tests read the registry. Code comment, so the bracketed placeholder spelling there is fine.
- PR body patched: it now states the precedent #16844 changeset carried no declaration lines (matching the tree at 625b0c32b4) and names the ui parity tests as the pin; the Verification section reports an ablation on `ko` — the dev's own account, not judged.
- Card claim `File surface` (registry, lint pin, one changeset) — now narrower than the diff (ten locale packs, a second changeset, a comment); the widening is the one this review required, so the claim is stale rather than wrong; no flag.
- `Governed: no` — still right: `ui/AGENTS.md` and `ui/.github/workflows/**` are governed, `ui/.changeset/**` and `ui/packages/**` are not; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success on this head.
- Check-runs on `29111be8a75224b2c98eb1f9dfb995be6c132425` at review time: success — filter, Check Changeset (both runs), Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards (both), Flag docs affected, Check PR Size, Auto Label, Plan Test Core shards, Dogfood Regression Gate. Pending — Build Core, Build UI Deps, Test Core (1–8/8), Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, every Lint job (ESLint, docs & code guards, PM dispatch-gates, repo & tooling gates, CI release & engine gates, scoped ×3); Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI and the `Test UI (k/16)` shards have not started (they need Build UI Deps). Skipped by filter — UI Published Artifacts, Build Docs, Dogfood shards, Temporal Conformance. **Test UI now gated to run**: the diff carries `ui/**` paths (ten packs, one `ui/.changeset` file), which `filter`'s `ui` glob matches, so unlike f70fec4289 the shards are owed on this head; none has concluded yet, so the gate verdict on the locale tests is still open here. Judged on what has concluded; nothing concluded red.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts` — against ADR-0109 §2, the file's maintenance contract and the first consumer: unchanged in substance from f70fec4289 and holds; the comment now carries the ui/ label obligation, which closes the gap the prior record named. The ten labels make the registry widening whole on the console side: a zh step reads 「阅读应用文档」, not "Read package doc".

- **Must-fix — the i18n changeset is in a directory the release does not read, which `ui/AGENTS.md` forbids adding to.** `ui/AGENTS.md` line 181: changesets are written at the repo root `.changeset/` per the root Post-Task Checklist step 3; `@object-ui/*` and `@objectstack/*` are one fixed version group; `ui/.changeset/` holds only pre-merge leftovers not yet migrated, the root config does not read it, "⇒ ⛔ 别往里加新的". The tree confirms it: `ui/.changeset/` has no `config.json`, the root `.changeset/config.json` is the only changesets config and lists `@object-ui/i18n` in its fixed group, and its last commits are the ui import and release-lane merge. So `ui/.changeset/27002-chatbot-tool-labels-package-docs.md` is inert: `changeset version` never consumes it, `@object-ui/i18n`'s CHANGELOG never carries the two keys, and the `Clause-②`/`Metadata-protocol` lines in it are read by no gate — the `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-changeset-no-major` readers scan the root directory only, which is why `Check Changeset` is green on this head while a published package changes with, in effect, no changeset ("never none", AGENTS.md step 3). Nothing in CI catches this (`grep ui/.changeset scripts .github/workflows` is empty), so it rides through on green. Fix: move the file to `.changeset/27002-chatbot-tool-labels-package-docs.md` unchanged — its frontmatter, level and both declaration lines are already right there — or fold `'@object-ui/i18n': patch` into the existing spec changeset's frontmatter with its own paragraph; either is a one-move change.
- Should-fix (not blocking): the Chinese 维护者速读 and "What changes" sections of the PR body name `ui/.changeset/...` as the changeset's path; once moved, patch the two mentions so the body and tree agree.
- No new break found: the two keys are inside the `chatbot.tool` object in each pack (indentation and quoting match the surrounding lines; `en`/`zh` single-quoted, the eight others double-quoted as their files already are); no pack gains a key another lacks; `todo_write` and the GRADUATED five are untouched; the sentences test's `zh` ruled-sentence case is unaffected.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c203ef8349f6371f0b4fd79d15be3c1786e50f50`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts + .changeset/27002-chatbot-tool-labels-package-docs.md (moved from ui/.changeset/), .changeset/config.json, ui/AGENTS.md (changeset rule, line 181), .changeset/27002-service-ai-package-doc-tool-names.md, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt,ru,zh}.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.test.ts; the f70fec4289 and 29111be8a7 scopes (lint rule, spec invariant test, ADR-0109, plugin-chatbot label tests, cloud `claude/project-thread-eb1lm2` @ 799c4ab6f004) stand as judged in the two prior records and are untouched by this delta.

Delta review: one commit after `29111be8a75224b2c98eb1f9dfb995be6c132425` — `c203ef8349` "chore(changeset): move the i18n label changeset to the root .changeset (#27002)". `git diff -M 29111be8a7 c203ef8349` is a single 100%-similarity rename, `ui/.changeset/27002-chatbot-tool-labels-package-docs.md` to `.changeset/27002-chatbot-tool-labels-package-docs.md`, 0 insertions, 0 deletions; `git ls-tree c203ef8349 ui/.changeset/` lists no `27002-*` file. The net diff against `main` is still 14 files / +68 −2: the two root changesets, the registry, the lint test, the ten locale packs. No other file moved.

### ① Derived judgments

- The prior record's must-fix — the `@object-ui/i18n` changeset sat in `ui/.changeset/`, which the release does not read and `ui/AGENTS.md` ⛔ forbids adding to — is **answered, right**. The file now sits in the repo-root `.changeset/`, the one directory the only changesets config (`.changeset/config.json`) reads; that config's `fixed` group lists `@object-ui/i18n`, so `changeset version` consumes the file and the `@object-ui/i18n` CHANGELOG carries the two keys. Its content is byte-identical to what the prior record judged right: `'@object-ui/i18n': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, a summary naming both keys and the two tests it keeps green.
- All earlier derived judgments stand unchanged: the registry's two names match the cloud `service-ai` set exactly; `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES` / the lint accept-set widen by two; the ten packs each carry both `chatbot.tool.*` keys as sentences that equal neither the id nor the title-caser output; key sets are equal across packs.
- No new accept-set or public-surface change: a rename of a `.changeset/*.md` publishes nothing by itself.

### ② Semver level
